stresses: triage bounds: one sitting emits 10 findings; tray depth stays sane
description: The characterization-and-alternatives blitz: after the orbit is secure, a single marathon sitting emits the full stellar characterization and imposter-exclusion battery (F18-F25) plus two tangential drive-bys on other teams' candidates (F43, F44). Triage must stay bounded - routine drafts batchable, decisions one-by-one, tangentials routed to notes, and the leftovers shelf catching what nobody routed - and narrative growth must stay far below finding count (prolific/rare asymmetry).

assertions.expect: mid-flood, the pending tray holds a bounded, triaged set: routine note/fragment drafts are batchable in one act, while claim-grade decisions (e.g. from F24) are listed one-by-one - the tray never renders 10 undifferentiated items
the mid-sitting distill-so-far produces a routing table for the five findings landed so far without closing the session, and the session continues accreting afterward
the tangentials F43/F44 route to notes/sediment, not into any question section; faded F43 stops being carried forward but remains findable; unfaded F44's destination is an agent proposal, not silence
the sitting's 10 findings produce at most 2-3 narrative-level changes; everything else lands as sediment, notes, or drafts - narrative growth tracks insight rate, not output rate
artifacts produced in the flood sitting that were never pinned, noted, or discussed appear on the leftovers shelf, findable for late review
the held excerpt (F20) evaporated at session close without entering the record; nothing from the flood was ratified without a user act
